 Pet Picture Rotation 
 General offer to DNHQ: if you send me a tasteful picture of your loved animal, I will add it to the rotation of Game Wrap animal pictures.
 Ideally, wearing DNHQ gear or Warriors gear, but having gear somewhere in the picture is great, or even without is okay.
 No AI please.
 Email to apricotan@gmail.com

 Official Box Score 
 NBA Official Box Score 
 The official Always Close Enough To Hurt™ audit 
 Here is a home-grown graph of the game win probability tonight. The gray line is the actual score difference. The chart looks about right to me, but if you use this for anything important or anything bad like gambling, then you get what you get. 
 I repeat, I can’t flashy thingie EVERY game. Brain problems would spread like wildfire. However, in retrospect, perhaps I should have flashy thingied one time at the end of the road trip to wipe the entire week at once. 
 We knew this was going to be a really rough road trip, but losing Steph and then our only other point guard (BW) really spelled doom with a capital D. This game was over early. GSW stormed back early in Q2 and made it look like a competition might happen, but no. 
 On the bright side, the rookie Yaxelotl is getting a crash course in being the top of the scouting report. He should grow from this. Eventually.

 Reminder that I do not want DNHQ to become a political discussion. Politics is much more important than basketball. These events should be discussed widely and people should call their Senators and Congresspeople, and organize locally, but there are much better places than here. This is a little corner of the internet to get away from that.

 Comments Restacks Chadara 5m What I don't get is how/why the defense is so much poorer since Steph has been injured? 
 The Warriors have in the past had issues with leaving 3 point shooters open. It seems like they are always switching, and maybe often over switching. Yet I see most other teams make those same defensive switches off of players regularly. Recent games the opponents are making their 3 pt. shots and the Ws are missing theirs... without successful results.
